problem: Through a given point outside a proper straight line, construct an actual distinct parallel line.

proof_idea.original: Copy an angle through the given point and use I.27 to establish parallelism.
proof_idea.analytic: Translate the given line direction to the point: d=p+(b-a). Its nonzero direction proves p!=d; the outside-line premise forces nonzero transverse separation.

litex_code:
# Book I.31: through a point outside a given proper straight line, draw
# a distinct parallel line. The source copies an angle and applies I.27;
# here the translated endpoint gives an actual direction-preserving witness.
# Outside-line placement is explicit because Definition 23 excludes coincidence.
thm proposition_31:
    ? forall a, b, p cart(R, R):
        a != b
        not p $in geometry::main::line_through_points(a, b)
        =>:
            exist d cart(R, R) st {$parallel::are_parallel_lines(p, d, a, b)}
    have d cart(R, R) = (p(1)+b(1)-a(1), p(2)+b(2)-a(2))
    d(1) = p(1)+b(1)-a(1)
    d(2) = p(2)+b(2)-a(2)
    d(1)-p(1) = (p(1)+b(1)-a(1))-p(1) = b(1)-a(1)
    d(2)-p(2) = (p(2)+b(2)-a(2))-p(2) = b(2)-a(2)
    by contra:
        ? p != d
        p = d
        d(1) = p(1)
        d(2) = p(2)
        b(1)-a(1) = d(1)-p(1) = 0
        b(2)-a(2) = d(2)-p(2) = 0
        b(1) = a(1)
        b(2) = a(2)
        b = (b(1),b(2)) = (a(1),a(2)) = a
        impossible a != b
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(p, d)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    geometry::main::vec(p, d)(1) = d(1)-p(1) = b(1)-a(1) = geometry::main::vec(a, b)(1)
    geometry::main::vec(p, d)(2) = d(2)-p(2) = b(2)-a(2) = geometry::main::vec(a, b)(2)
    release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(geometry::main::vec(p, d), geometry::main::vec(a, b))
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, d), geometry::main::vec(a, b)) = geometry::main::vec(a, b)(1)*geometry::main::vec(a, b)(2)-geometry::main::vec(a, b)(2)*geometry::main::vec(a, b)(1) = 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_parallel(p, d, a, b)
    by contra:
        ? geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, d), geometry::main::vec(p, a)) != 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, d), geometry::main::vec(p, a)) = 0
        release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(p, d, a)
        release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(a, p, b)
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, d), geometry::main::vec(p, a)) = (d(1)-p(1))*(a(2)-p(2))-(d(2)-p(2))*(a(1)-p(1))
        (d(1)-p(1))*(a(2)-p(2))-(d(2)-p(2))*(a(1)-p(1)) = (b(1)-a(1))*(a(2)-p(2))-(b(2)-a(2))*(a(1)-p(1)) = (p(1)-a(1))*(b(2)-a(2))-(p(2)-a(2))*(b(1)-a(1))
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, p), geometry::main::vec(a, b)) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, d), geometry::main::vec(p, a)) = 0
        p $in geometry::main::line_through_points(a, b)
        impossible not p $in geometry::main::line_through_points(a, b)
    by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(p, d, a, b)
    witness exist q cart(R, R) st {$parallel::are_parallel_lines(p, q, a, b)} from d
